nodes.label: Execution costs
nodes.rationale: Fixed and proportional commissions plus adverse directional slippage reduce net returns and can eliminate marginal trade profitability.

nodes.label: Turnover metrics
nodes.rationale: Gross turnover uses full traded notional, margin-adjusted turnover scales futures notional by margin, and annualized variants normalize by trading days.

nodes.label: IBKR historical data
nodes.rationale: ib_insync connects to TWS with separate caching, request pacing, history limits, and futures contract overrides or automatic rolling.

nodes.label: multi_factor_v1
nodes.rationale: Optional trend, volatility, credit, and rates regime model preserves the legacy simple_sma alternative and existing configurations.

nodes.label: Parameter search
nodes.rationale: A separate tuning package supports grid, random, and Optuna search; journals enable resume and duplicate avoidance, while quick evaluation filters candidates before full backtests.

nodes.label: Static OHLCV data
nodes.rationale: Local CSV inputs support resampling and explicit ticker mapping; missing symbols fail instead of silently falling back to yfinance.

nodes.label: Ablation configuration
nodes.rationale: Compares the default strategy suite using leave-one-out, add-one-in, strategy groups, time splits, and engine or strategy parameter grids.

nodes.label: Double bottom exit ablation
nodes.rationale: Named parameter sets compare DoubleBottomRsiDivergence trailing activation and partial take-profit percentages against the default configuration.

nodes.label: Structure break ablation
nodes.rationale: Tests Fibonacci target preference, a lower reward-to-risk floor, and an ATR retest band to relax MarketAlignedStructureBreak entry constraints.

nodes.label: Trend exit ablation
nodes.rationale: Three parameter sets progressively combine decay exits, AboveEmaState50 confirmation, EMA trailing, and later or fewer add-ons using backtest_trend_only_ablation_base.yaml.

nodes.label: Combined double bottom trend
nodes.rationale: Combines DoubleBottomRsiDivergence with enabled flag, triangle, and support/resistance strategies; PullbackToEma and DonchianBreakout are configured but disabled.

nodes.label: DoubleBottomRsiDivergence confirmations
nodes.rationale: Runs double-bottom entries with BullishEngulfing and CloseAboveEma20 confirmation-only helpers, partial exits, staged trailing, exhaustion protection, and one add-on after trend confirmation.

nodes.label: Ablation baseline
nodes.rationale: A reduced comparison baseline enables PullbackToEma, BullishEngulfing, VptBreakout, GoldenCross, and MacdTurnaround.

nodes.label: Execution cost experiment
nodes.rationale: Adds fixed and proportional commissions and two basis points of slippage to evaluate execution cost sensitivity.

nodes.label: Deployment sizing experiment
nodes.rationale: Raises trade_size to 6000 and max_alloc_pct to 0.9 to evaluate higher capital deployment.

nodes.label: Risk-on short experiment
nodes.rationale: Enables allow_short_risk_on to evaluate short entries during risk-on regimes.

nodes.label: Turnover reduction experiment
nodes.rationale: Tightens PullbackToEma trend, volatility, pullback-distance, regime-stability, and loss-cooldown requirements to reduce turnover.

nodes.label: Long-term support resistance
nodes.rationale: Runs LongTermSupportResistanceBreakRetest with weekly levels and daily execution, larger sizing for infrequent trades, TrendGate confirmation, and setups armed across regime changes.

nodes.label: MarketAlignedStructureBreak
nodes.rationale: Daily structure breaks require retest and confirmation, room and reward-to-risk filters, Fibonacci extension targets, and bounded stop distances within a single core book.

nodes.label: Futures margin capital basis
nodes.rationale: Futures margin translates gross notional into capital usage for allocation, position caps, and invested exposure; futures quantities are floored to integers.

nodes.label: Profit protection
nodes.rationale: Breakeven, trailing stops, partial exits, giveback exits, and decay exits trade off profit retention, upside participation, and capital tied up in stalled trades.

nodes.label: Regime gates
nodes.rationale: Trend state, volatility state, and risk-on probability control strategy entry eligibility; optional regime buckets scale risk and hysteresis reduces threshold oscillation.

nodes.label: Risk-based sizing
nodes.rationale: Current equity times risk_per_trade_pct determines the risk budget; quantity divides that budget by stop distance times multiplier and is constrained by trade and allocation caps.

nodes.label: Fixed parameters
nodes.rationale: Keep universe, time windows, data plumbing, market dependencies, output settings, and costs fixed by default; costs vary only for explicit stress tests.

nodes.label: Regime tuning
nodes.rationale: Use small ranges for risk-on thresholds, hysteresis, hedge limits, risk buckets, and exposure caps; keep regime symbols, intraday alignment, and missing-data policies fixed.

nodes.label: Strategy discovery
nodes.rationale: New strategy files inherit BaseStrategy and implement check; automatic discovery avoids manual registration.

nodes.label: Book allocator
nodes.rationale: Core and convex books have separate risk budgets and drawdown controls; portfolio drawdowns reduce sizing and disable add-ons.

nodes.label: Confirmation-only helpers
nodes.rationale: entry_enabled=false helpers supply confirmation signals without opening positions; shared trend entries require TrendGate and AboveEmaState20, while double bottom uses BullishEngulfing and CloseAboveEma20.

nodes.label: Complementary regime filters
nodes.rationale: Sma200RsiOversoldFib uses MKT_RISK_ON_MEAN_REVERSION, while short VTX-BRK inverts the same filter; both disable generic regime exits.

nodes.label: Shifted weekly levels
nodes.rationale: Weekly support/resistance levels use levels_shift=1 before daily execution to avoid lookahead.

nodes.label: Prompt-aware semantic extraction cache

nodes.label: Parallel semantic extraction
nodes.rationale: Document, paper, and image concepts require semantic interpretation; related files are grouped into chunks while AST extraction runs concurrently.
